issue.subject: bluefs_alloc_size / bluefs_shared_alloc_size that are not a power of 2 are accepted, then abort in the allocator
issue.description:
|Kind|crash at mkfs instead of a validation error| |Severity|minor| |Config|@bluefs_shared_alloc_size@ (single device) or @bluefs_alloc_size@ (dedicated DB/WAL) set to a non-power-of-2 value; both options are level advanced (defaults 64K and 1M)| |Real-world|*Real tool*: @ceph-osd --mkfs@ crashes| |Affected|main. Reproduced on origin/main 8e6a13e7a9a| h3. Summary @BlueFS::_init_alloc()@ (BlueFS.cc:823-915) only asserts that @bluefs_shared_alloc_size@ is a multiple of @min_alloc_size@ (@ceph_assert(0 == p2phase(shared_alloc_size, unit))@, 841) and that @bluefs_alloc_size@ is non-zero (@ceph_assert(alloc_size[id])@, 873). The first BlueFS allocation then passes the unit to the allocator, which aborts with @ceph_assert(std::has_single_bit(unit))@ (HybridAllocator_impl.h:27). The only power-of-2 check is in the admin-socket "bluefs device info" command (BlueFS.cc:141). By reading (not reproduced): on an existing OSD, the crash happens at the first BlueFS allocation after the option is changed. h3. Reproduction @repro.sh@: mkfs a single-device OSD with @--bluefs-shared-alloc-size=96K@; mkfs with a dedicated DB and @--bluefs-alloc-size=1536K@; control with defaults. h3. Observed (origin/main 8e6a13e7a9a) 
== control (defaults)
  [control] mkfs+fsck ok
== single device, bluefs_shared_alloc_size=96K (multiple of 4K min_alloc, not pow2)
  [shared96K] mkfs CRASHED:
    src/os/bluestore/HybridAllocator_impl.h: 27: FAILED ceph_assert(std::has_single_bit(unit))
== dedicated DB, bluefs_alloc_size=1536K
  [db1536K] mkfs CRASHED:
    src/os/bluestore/HybridAllocator_impl.h: 27: FAILED ceph_assert(std::has_single_bit(unit))
h3. Suggested fix Validate both options in @_init_alloc()@ / mkfs (power of 2, >= min_alloc_size) and fail with -EINVAL. h3. Reproducer files * "repro.sh":https://github.com/cephtools/tools/tree/main/trackers/bluestore-2026-09/23-bluefs-alloc-size-non-pow2-abort/repro.sh * Test patch for all gtests: "bluestore-bughunt-tests.patch":https://github.com/cephtools/tools/tree/main/trackers/bluestore-2026-09/common/patches/bluestore-bughunt-tests.patch
